description: This file is an auth controller module for a Node.js web application using Express. It handles user authentication workflows such as registration, login, token refresh, email verification, password reset, and OAuth callback, utilizing Prisma ORM for database operations, bcryptjs for password hashing, jwt for token management, and zod for input validation.

methods.name: export async function register(req: Request, res: Response) { register
methods.description: Registers a new user, creates an email verification token, and responds with success message.

methods.description: Validates user credentials and issues JWT and refresh tokens.

methods.name: export async function refresh(req: Request, res: Response) { refresh
methods.description: Issues a new access token using a provided refresh token.

methods.name: export async function logout(_req: Request, res: Response) { logout
methods.description: Handles logout request; client should discard tokens.

methods.name: export async function verifyEmail(req: Request, res: Response) { verifyEmail
methods.description: Verifies a user's email using a token.

methods.name: export async function resendVerification(req: Request, res: Response) { resendVerification
methods.description: Resends email verification token to user email.

methods.name: export async function forgotPassword(req: Request, res: Response) { forgotPassword
methods.description: Creates a password reset token and simulates sending email.

methods.name: export async function resetPassword(req: Request, res: Response) { resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user's password using a valid token.

methods.description: Stub for handling Google OAuth callback.
